text: dsh-scratchpad 是供 DeepSeek Harness 网页端其他插件调用的共享浮动文本面板，通过 scratchpad 客户端服务打开并显示在 shell overlay 中。它支持只读查看、编辑后通过回调保存，以及可选的前后文本差异展示；面板提供滚动文本区、行号、键盘关闭和保存操作。调用方传入文本与可选标题，也可提供保存回调接收编辑结果；内容由调用方管理，不会持久保存。适合需要在 DSH 页面内预览或修改较长文本的插件。

dsh-scratchpad gives DeepSeek Harness web plugins a shared floating text panel. Callers can show scrollable read-only text, enable editing and receive saved changes, or request an optional before-and-after view. The caller owns the text; it is not persisted.
想让其他 DSH 插件弹出一个可滚动的大文本查看面板
需要在网页端让用户修改一段文本，并把保存结果交回调用方
How can a DSH web plugin show a temporary before-and-after text comparison?
dsh-scratchpad 的功能「查看与编辑文本」：其他插件调用 scratchpad.open 打开浮动面板，可用只读模式展示文本，或启用编辑并通过 onSave 将修改后的内容交回调用方。

dsh-scratchpad README · dsh-scratchpad：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH)
plugin: one shared floating text surface in the middle of the screen that
any plugin can open, for reading big text or editing it in place.

There is no UI of its own to visit. Other plugins open the pad through the
client service `scratchpad`:

dsh-scratchpad README · Modes：- **Read**: text is not editable, there is no Save, Close is the only
  action; a backdrop click also closes. Selecting and copying work
  (`readOnly`, never `disabled`).
- **Edit**: Save + Cancel. Save calls `onSave(editedText)` and closes. A
  backdrop click does not close (no stray-click data loss). Editable
  without `onSave` is allowed: a draft pad, where Close discards.
- `Escape` closes (discarding edits in edit mode); `Ctrl/Cmd+Enter` saves.

dsh-scratchpad README · Contract：- `open` replaces whatever the pad shows (one pad per tab).
- Validation: `text` must be a string of at most 2 MB; `onSave` without
  `editable: true` throws. Fail loud at the door.
- No return value; no persistence. A throwing `onSave` keeps the pad open
  with the error surfaced in the footer.
- Pad state survives session switches (module scope) but not page reloads.

dsh-scratchpad README · How to install：Requires a DeepSeek Harness checkout and a profile, here `web`. The plugin
has no dependencies:

```sh
mkdir -p ~/dsh-plugins && cd ~/dsh-plugins
git clone https://github.com/joao-paulo-santos/dsh-scratchpad.git
dsh-scratchpad README · from the harness checkout：pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add ~/dsh-plugins/dsh-scratchpad

dsh-scratchpad README · verify the profile still composes：pnpm dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

Restart the harness. Plugins that inject the `scratchpad` service can now
open the pad.

dsh-scratchpad README · Dependencies：- [dsh-diff-view](https://github.com/joao-paulo-santos/dsh-diff-view) renders `mode: 'diff'` pads (optional; without it a diff pad degrades to a plain before/after view)

dsh-scratchpad README · Plugins dependent on this：- [dsh-granular-prompt](https://github.com/joao-paulo-santos/dsh-granular-prompt) opens the pad for full-text viewing, section replacement, and diff review
